## What this can and cannot show

- It shows how far from the middle of this set each flagged repository is on each measure.
- It does not show why. A repository can be far out on every measure because of a launch, a newsletter, a trend, a list or a tutorial, and also for other reasons.
- Contributors are recorded only for the repositories the tool enriched (the top of each category and the watchlist), so that row describes a subset.
- Percentiles depend on the snapshot's queries. Re-run the tool on a later snapshot to see how the picture moves.
